rule: flag as malicious if P(malicious) >= threshold
how_chosen: minimises C_FN*FN + C_FP*FP over every distinct score on TRAIN out-of-fold predictions (persisted 3-fold CV of the train split, data/splits/cv_fold_ids; tuned params, fixed 479 rounds as the refit); cut placed midway to the next lower score. No test set was used.
caveat: classes are 50/50 by construction; re-derive the threshold for a deployment with another prevalence
